summary.text: Dan Hyatt is the Republican candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 87, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where Democratic incumbent Connie Steinmetz is also on the ballot.

paragraphs.text: Dan Hyatt advanced from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary for District 87 as the only candidate on the ballot.

Ballotpedia also lists him as a candidate in District 72 in 2016, when incumbent Mary Nichols defeated him in the general election, and in the 2024 District 87 Republican primary, which John Rommel won.
